comments.story: Japan's zero-gravity space drone sends first pictures from ISS
comments.why: Reaction wheels with braking transfer momentum to the body
comments.text: From a related video: the reaction wheels spin up while keeping total angular momentum at zero, then apply a rapid (magnetic) brake to transfer the momentum to the body (from the wheels). I'm assuming if you do that precisely enough (and in three dimensions), you can generate linear movement. EDIT: I'm probably very wrong about the movement. EDIT: The video: [VIDEO]
